definitions.explanation: A moment of noticing or realizing something, often something previously overlooked. Also used for personal insights or discoveries gained through experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{気|き}づき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気|き}づき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I write down my everyday insights in a notebook.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}して→通す：02300_toosu⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気|き}づき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was able to gain many insights through the training.

notes:
USAGE:
Derived from the verb {気|き}づく (to notice, to realize). As a noun, {気|き}づき emphasizes the moment or content of realization rather than the act itself. Widely used in business and self-improvement contexts to describe insights or observations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気|き}づき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to gain an insight
- {気|き}づき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a realization
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{気|き}づき: new awareness
- {気|き}づき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to give someone an insight
